conclusion_en:
The equation form was not reproducible: when re-searched in each fold, the retainer × log(integrals) form
reappeared in only 1 of 5 folds, although every fold used the slurry-flow and air-bag pressure integrals.
Against linear regression with the same variables, the gain was unclear for A-456 (better in 2/5 folds) and
small for B-456 (better in 4/5 folds; out-of-fold RMSE 4.80 vs 4.94).
